summary: {"summary":"plan.md fixes the exact coordinates for all six kit plots. It reads as the Brooklyn Bridge because of two stone-brick towers with sandstone trim, each cut by twin pointed arches (crowns at y48) with recessed rings and hoods; four pale quartz cables over saddles at y57; and diorite-wall suspenders every 3 crossed by fans of 16 (main span) and 12 (side span) stays.\nThe deck has sandstone lattice trusses, grey roads at y27 and a spruce promenade at y30 with dark fences and lanterns, split round the central pier. The granite anchorage has round-arched vaults, the arched approach repeats along z, and lanterns light every walk surface.\nThree brief conflicts are named: the inner cable housings are 2 wide, not 3, to keep the road and promenade clear; plot 5 needs a height cap of y26, not y22, to fit its y23 promenade; and no chain is used (the toolkit rejects it)."}
